name: Lieutenant Paval Reethe
summary: At the Shady Rest Inn, Lieutenant Paval Reethe's badge lies beneath the rubble, marked with Theramore's sign. Bring it to Captain Garran Vimes in Theramore.

sections.title: A Glint in the Rubble
sections.body: Ash and debris bury a badge in the Shady Rest Inn ruins. Beneath it, Lieutenant Paval Reethe's name lies below Theramore's sign. Captain Garran Vimes in Theramore asks what you found, and the badge belongs in his hands.

sections.title: The Captain's Reply
sections.body: Captain Garran Vimes says a guard's badge brings grim news. Some guards fall in battle, and he must carry word to their grieving families. Others vanish, leaving their fate unknown. At times, the truth is worse still.

faq.answer: The badge lies beneath rubble, ash, and debris in the Shady Rest Inn ruins. Captain Garran Vimes asks what you found there.

faq.q: Whose name is on the badge?
faq.answer: Lieutenant Paval Reethe's name is embossed beneath the anchor.

aliases: who do i give the badge to
faq.answer: Captain Garran Vimes in Theramore should see the badge.

faq.q: What does the badge look like?
aliases: what does the badge look like
faq.answer: The badge bears a gold anchor over white enamel, Theramore's sign.

attribution: Classic quest text: Lieutenant Paval Reethe
